How It Works

4 Stages of a Condition Audit

From an unclear list of complaints to a funded, prioritised maintenance plan

1

Condition Audit

We walk the property and record the current condition of every audited area

2

Prioritisation

Each defect assigned a priority tier based on safety, consequence and deterioration rate

3

Repair & Cost Guidance

Recommended repair method and cost guidance for each item, grouped by phase

4

Re-Audit Schedule

We propose when to re-audit so deterioration is tracked, not discovered

Priority Tiers

Every Defect Given a Priority

So your budget goes to the right repairs, in the right order

Urgent

Safety or structural risk — act now, before the next budget cycle

Soon

Deteriorating — address within 6 to 12 months

Planned

Include in the normal maintenance cycle and budget

Monitor

No action needed now — re-check at the next audit
